painted_metal.label: Composite panel
painted_metal.prompt: large flat cool-gray aluminum composite panels, smooth matte metal, exactly four equal columns and four equal rows filling the frame. Solid near-black joints about one fifth as wide as each panel, running edge to edge so the tile repeats. Wall, floor, and ceiling use this same grid, the same panel count, the same joint width, and the same colors. If an example image is attached, copy only the flat gray panel color and draw the joints several times thicker than the example. No thin lines, no caulk, no rivets, no chips, no rust, no teal, no sky, no logo, no perspective, no building corner

item_icon.label: Item icon

item_icon.suffix: Painted game icon for a 96 pixel inventory slot. One object, centered. Leave about 5 percent empty margin on every side so the object does not touch the edge. Show the object from the side, in profile. The area outside the object is empty alpha. No numbers. Keep the shapes large and painted. This is not a seamless texture.
